build_sh:
#!/bin/bash -eu
set -eu
cd /src/zlib

# Build zlib using its configure+make system
# $CC and $CFLAGS are set by the base image compile wrapper (with UBSan flags)
./configure
make -j$(nproc)

# Build harness statically linked against the instrumented libz.a
# (avoids runtime loading the system's uninstrumented libz.so)
$CC $CFLAGS -I . /src/harness.c -o /src/harness_bin ./libz.a
secb_sh:
#!/bin/bash

build() {
    echo "BUILDING THE PROJECT..."
    if /usr/local/bin/compile 1>/dev/null; then
        echo "BUILD COMPLETED SUCCESSFULLY!"
    else
        echo "BUILD FAILED!"
        exit 1
    fi
}

repro() {
    echo "REPRODUCING THE ISSUE FOR zlib.issue-1222..."
    /src/harness_bin /testcase/poc.bin
    # NOTE: YOU SHOULD NOT RETURN/EXIT 0 IN THIS FUNCTION.
}

patch() {
    echo "PATCHING THE PROJECT..."
    cd /src/zlib
    if git apply /testcase/model_patch.diff; then
        echo "PATCH APPLIED SUCCESSFULLY!"
    else
        echo "PATCH APPLICATION FAILED!"
        exit 1
    fi
}

if [ "$#" -ge 1 ]; then
    command="$1"

    case "$command" in
        build)
            build "$@"
            ;;
        repro)
            repro "$@"
            ;;
        patch)
            patch "$@"
            ;;
        *)
            echo "Unknown command: $command"
            echo "Usage: secb [build|repro|patch]"
            exit 1
            ;;
    esac
else
    echo "Usage: secb [build|repro|patch]"
    exit 1
fi
dockerfile:
FROM hwiwonlee/secb.base:latest
ENV FUZZING_LANGUAGE=c
ENV SANITIZER=undefined
ENV UBSAN_OPTIONS=halt_on_error=1:print_stacktrace=1:silence_unsigned_overflow=1
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y git
RUN git clone https://github.com/madler/zlib.git zlib \
    && cd zlib \
    && git checkout f9dd6009be3ed32415edf1e89d1bc38380ecb95d \
    && rm -rf .git \
    && git init \
    && git config user.email "secbench@local" \
    && git config user.name "secbench" \
    && git add -A && git commit -m "zlib at f9dd600 (pre-patch)"
WORKDIR $SRC/zlib
COPY harness.c $SRC/harness.c
COPY build.sh $SRC/
RUN mkdir -p /testcase
COPY poc.bin /testcase/poc.bin

bug_report:
================= Bug Report (1/1) ==================
## Source: GitHub Issue
## URL: https://github.com/madler/zlib/issues/1222
## Description:
Issue: madler/zlib#1222
Title: Signed Integer Overflow in gzseek64 when Normalizing a SEEK_SET Offset
State: open

Issue Body:
A signed integer overflow occurs in zlib's gzseek64 function (invoked through the public gzseek API) when a caller passes a sufficiently negative offset with whence == SEEK_SET. The function unconditionally subtracts the current stream position from the user-supplied offset before performing any range validation, which can overflow the signed 64-bit z_off64_t type and triggers undefined behavior.

Version: v1.3.2-14-gf9dd600

gzseek64 normalizes a SEEK_SET request into a SEEK_CUR-style delta via:

  /* gzlib.c */
  z_off64_t ZEXPORT gzseek64(gzFile file, z_off64_t offset, int whence) {
      ...
      /* normalize offset to a SEEK_CUR specification */
      if (whence == SEEK_SET)
          offset -= state->x.pos;          /* <-- line 389, overflow site */
      ...
      /* calculate skip amount, rewinding if needed for back seek when reading */
      if (offset < 0) {
          if (state->mode != GZ_READ)      /* writing -- can't go backwards */
              return -1;
          offset += state->x.pos;
          if (offset < 0)                  /* before start of file! */
              return -1;                   /* <-- intended error path */
          ...
      }

offset and state->x.pos are both z_off64_t (signed 64-bit). When the caller supplies offset == INT64_MIN (-9223372036854775808) and state->x.pos > 0 (which happens as soon as any byte has been read/written), the subtraction INT64_MIN - state->x.pos overflows the signed type — this is undefined behavior in C, as flagged by UBSan.

Stack Trace:
gzlib.c:389:16: runtime error: signed integer overflow: -9223372036854775808 - 1 cannot be represented in type 'off64_t' (aka 'long')
    #0 in gzseek64 /src/zlib/gzlib.c:389:16
    #1 in gzseek   /src/zlib/gzlib.c:441:11
SUMMARY: UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer: undefined-behavior gzlib.c:389:16
